existing_replacement_evidence.qualification: Replacement comparison only. Cover hole count/phase, thread, recess and axial interface remain assumptions in the accepted flywheel model.

cad_boundary.cover_holes: Accepted study uses six radius4.2 mm blind holes at radius147.5 mm and30-degree phase, local Z15..25; count, phase and thread are not sourced.
cad_boundary.requested_extension: Engine-side cover, pressure ring, diaphragm and sprung-disc functional decomposition. Keep pilot/release interfaces unresolved until dimensions and transmission variant are established.

prohibited_inferences: Do not select11-inch simply because it is larger or treat the10-inch option as an error;10-inch is the owner-configuration baseline inference, not an inspected installed disc.
Do not import7.3L diesel or7.5L clutch fastener dimensions from the adjacent mixed-application service text.
Do not infer real diaphragm-finger or damper-spring counts from an oblique schematic.
Do not infer pilot bearing identity from a matching shaft bore or unrelated Dodge/Jeep catalog item.
Do not claim release travel, clamp force, torque rating or physical installed fit from static decomposition.
